content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will be holding a Regular Meeting on Wednesday, July 24, 2024 at 9am; the meeting agenda can be found here. Please note: The Regular Meeting will be an online-only meeting and can be viewed via livestream on the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.

Public comment for this meeting can be provided via online submission. To electronically submit written public comments for this meeting, please complete the form here. Electronic submission of public comment will be accepted until 8:00 am on Wednesday, July 24, 2024.  During the meeting, all electronically submitted public comment will be read aloud by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes in length per comment. Anonymous comments will not be read. 

The purpose of public comment is for members of our Board of Directors to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Board members will not respond to submitted public comments.
